                ACTIVE_VAR = zg361_case_af_active
                EXPECTED_OWNER = var:zg361_case_af_owner
                EXPECTED_SUBJECT = this
                EXPECTED_CYCLE = var:zg361_case_af_cycle_serial
                EXPECTED_CASE = var:zg361_case_af_case_serial
                EXPECTED_STATE = 1
            }
            has_variable = zg361_comp_m292_receipt_active
            var:zg361_comp_m292_receipt_active = 0

            trigger_if = {
                limit = { scope:zg361_comp_route = 3 var:zg361_comp_m290_eligible = 1 }
                var:zg361_case_af_owner = {
                    has_treasury = yes
                    treasury >= 7
                    gold >= 3
                }
                var:zg361_comp_af_treasury_available >= 7
                var:zg361_comp_af_personal_available >= 3
                trigger_if = {
                    limit = { has_variable = zg361_comp_m292_cash_treasury_status }
                    var:zg361_comp_m292_cash_treasury_status = 0
                }
                trigger_else = { always = yes }
            }
            trigger_else = { always = yes }
        }
        zg361_case_kernel_record_operation_effect = {
            OWNER_VAR = zg361_case_af_owner
            SUBJECT_VAR = zg361_case_af_subject
            CYCLE_VAR = zg361_case_af_cycle_serial
            CASE_VAR = zg361_case_af_case_serial
            STATE_VAR = zg361_case_af_state
            ACTIVE_VAR = zg361_case_af_active
            REVISION_VAR = zg361_case_af_revision
            TIMELINE_VAR = zg361_case_af_timeline_serial
            FEEDBACK_VAR = zg361_case_af_feedback_revision
            LAST_OPERATION_VAR = zg361_comp_af_last_operation
            LAST_CHOICE_VAR = zg361_comp_af_last_route
            RECEIPT_OWNER_VAR = zg361_comp_m292_receipt_owner
            RECEIPT_SUBJECT_VAR = zg361_comp_m292_receipt_subject
            RECEIPT_CYCLE_VAR = zg361_comp_m292_receipt_cycle
            RECEIPT_CASE_VAR = zg361_comp_m292_receipt_case
            RECEIPT_STATE_VAR = zg361_comp_m292_receipt_state
            RECEIPT_CHOICE_VAR = zg361_comp_m292_receipt_route
            TICKET_OWNER = var:zg361_case_af_owner
            TICKET_SUBJECT = this
            TICKET_CYCLE = var:zg361_case_af_cycle_serial
            TICKET_CASE = var:zg361_case_af_case_serial
            TICKET_STATE = 1
            CHOICE = scope:zg361_comp_route
            OPERATION_ID = 292
        }
        if = {
            limit = { var:zg361_case_kernel_applied = 1 }
            if = {
                limit = { scope:zg361_comp_route = 3 var:zg361_comp_m290_eligible = 1 }
                zg361_comp_af_pay_cash_alternative_effect = yes
            }
            else = { set_variable = { name = zg361_comp_financial_applied value = 1 } }
            if = {
                limit = { var:zg361_comp_financial_applied = 1 }
                set_variable = { name = zg361_comp_m292_receipt_active value = 1 }
                set_variable = { name = zg361_comp_m292_route value = scope:zg361_comp_route }
                set_variable = { name = zg361_comp_m292_value value = 0 }
                if = { limit = { scope:zg361_comp_route = 1 } set_variable = { name = zg361_comp_m292_value value = 1 } }
                else_if = { limit = { scope:zg361_comp_route = 2 } set_variable = { name = zg361_comp_m292_value value = -1 } }
                zg361_comp_m292_consume_effect = yes
                set_variable = { name = zg361_comp_last_disposition value = 1 }
                set_variable = { name = zg361_comp_runtime_applied value = 1 }
            }
        }
    }
    else = {
        if = {
            limit = {
                var:zg361_comp_m292_receipt_active = 1
                var:zg361_comp_m292_receipt_owner = var:zg361_case_af_owner
                var:zg361_comp_m292_receipt_subject = this
                var:zg361_comp_m292_receipt_cycle = var:zg361_case_af_cycle_serial
                var:zg361_comp_m292_receipt_case = var:zg361_case_af_case_serial
                var:zg361_comp_m292_receipt_state = 1
            }
            if = {
                limit = { var:zg361_comp_m292_receipt_route = scope:zg361_comp_route }
                set_variable = { name = zg361_comp_last_disposition value = 2 }
            }
            else = {
                set_variable = { name = zg361_comp_typed_red value = 3 }
                set_variable = { name = zg361_comp_last_disposition value = -1 }
            }
        }
        else = { set_variable = { name = zg361_comp_last_disposition value = 3 } }
    }
}

zg361_comp_m292_consume_effect = {

                else_if = {
                    limit = { var:zg361_comp_m292_route = 3 }

        zg361_comp_af_recalculate_units_effect = yes

        if = {

                var:zg361_pp_m147_receipt_active = 1

                var:zg361_pp_m147_consumed = 1
                has_variable = zg361_pp_m147_receipt_owner
                var:zg361_pp_m147_receipt_owner = var:zg361_comp_result_owner
                has_variable = zg361_pp_m147_receipt_subject
                var:zg361_pp_m147_receipt_subject = var:zg361_comp_result_subject
                has_variable = zg361_pp_m147_receipt_cycle
                var:zg361_pp_m147_receipt_cycle = var:zg361_comp_result_cycle
                has_variable = zg361_pp_m147_receipt_serial
                var:zg361_pp_m147_receipt_serial = var:zg361_comp_result_case
                has_variable = zg361_pp_m147_receipt_revision
                var:zg361_pp_m147_receipt_revision > 0
                var:zg361_comp_m292_receipt_active = 1
                var:zg361_comp_m292_consumed = 1
                var:zg361_comp_m292_visible_revision > 0
            }
            set_variable = { name = zg361_comp_promotion_receipt_active value = 1 }
            set_variable = { name = zg361_comp_promotion_receipt_posted value = 1 }

            set_variable = { name = zg361_comp_promotion_receipt_cycle value = var:zg361_comp_result_cycle }
